Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-moridon-akihuyu/

Hanno is a town of greenery and clear streams. In the past, timber cut in the mountains was lashed into rafts and floated down to Edo and Tokyo for use as lumber.

【Fee】¥3,500 per person (includes guide, insurance, lunch, and light refreshments)

【Capacity】10 people

【Guide】Mori no Donguri-dan staff

【What to bring】drinking water, rain gear, ground cloth (picnic blanket), trekking poles (if you have them)
